entities.summary: Isaiah Jamar Thomas is an American professional basketball player who last played for the Salt Lake City Stars of the NBA G League. He most notably played with the Boston Celtics from 2015 through 2017, when he was a two-time NBA All-Star and named second-team All-NBA.
